author_inference_review: Numerical comparison against pinned author inference: validation/native-parity.json

checkpoint_origin.verification: Original general tracking ONNX; no conversion or fine-tuning.

deployment.history: Five samples per observation term; zero-filled new buffers; two initial observations from BaseEnv.reset and MosaicEnv.reset.
deployment.reference_timing: At action k, reference max(k-1,0); follows observation-before-reference-increment in original step sequence.
deployment.reference_coordinates: Common initial-reference torso XY/yaw coordinate registration for actual and reference packets; no physics or scoring coordinates changed. Only orientation enters the policy.
deployment.offline_route: MosaicEnv, eval_mode=true, use_teleop=false, use_estimator=false, history_length=5, command_horizon=1; the released default control YAML enables teleoperation and must be explicitly disabled for offline references.
deployment.canonical_reference: Canonical first frame is retained. No NPZ file is used; the author MotionLoader [1:] file-format slicing is not applied to the canonical benchmark trajectory.
deployment.clip_reset: Fresh per-clip controller history, equivalent to independent author environment construction. No model resets inside a clip.
deployment.endpoint: Hold last canonical reference, no looping.
